title: Sharp spectral-scale stability for parabolic equations with measure-valued delay
summary: We study the dependence of parabolic solution operators on a finite signed measure describing the delay law. For a positive self-adjoint generator with compact inverse, a weighted dyadic spectral sum characterizes the norm of the semigroup-integrated memory perturbation. An exact realization identity transfers the matching lower estimate to two positive point delays in a fixed linear equation, using a common smooth, finite-spectral history.
